title: Deeper C#
units/0/blurb: What every object has: System.Object, the header and the type pointer, the Equals/GetHashCode contract; casts, is, as and unboxing; primitives, checked and overflow, dynamic and its cost.
units/1/blurb: Why they exist, how the JIT compiles them for value and reference types, where constraints, covariance and contravariance, and generic math with INumber<T>.
units/2/blurb: Func and Action, multicast delegates, events and subscription leaks, lambdas and exactly what they capture.
units/3/blurb: Deferred execution and Take, ToList and multiple enumeration, the buffering OrderBy, IQueryable and SQL from lambdas.
units/4/blurb: Span<T> and copy-free slices, the rules of ref struct and Memory<T>, readonly struct, in and defensive copies.
units/5/blurb: Pattern matching, records, nullable references, required and what is new in C# 12, 13 and 14. The course final.
